description: This Python source file provides functions for extracting and processing text data from PDF and DOCX files, along with methods for parsing raw resume content to identify structured information such as name, email, phone number, and skills.

methods.name: str _clean_text(text: str)
methods.description: Cleans and normalizes the extracted text by replacing null characters, collapsing whitespace, and reducing multiple newlines.

methods.name: str extract_text_from_pdf(data: bytes)
methods.description: Extracts and cleans text content from a PDF byte stream.

methods.name: str extract_text_from_docx(data: bytes)
methods.description: Extracts and cleans text content from a DOCX byte stream.

methods.name: str extract_text(filename: str, content_type: Optional[str], data: bytes)
methods.description: Determines the file type based on filename or content type and extracts text accordingly, falling back to UTF-8 decoding.

methods.name: List[str] _find_emails(text: str)
methods.description: Uses regex to find unique email addresses within the text.

methods.name: Optional[str] _find_phone(text: str)
methods.description: Uses regex to find a phone number within the text.

methods.name: Optional[str] _guess_name(text: str)
methods.description: Naively guesses a person's name from the first plausible non-empty line in the text.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] extract_structured_fields(raw_text: str)
methods.description: Main public function that extracts structured resume data such as name, email, phone, and skills from raw text.

ctags.name: extract_text
ctags.pattern: /^def extract_text(filename: str, content_type: Optional[str], data: bytes) -> str:$/
